name: Headlight Beam
description: Translucent light cone for a submarine headlight or flashlight: apex at the origin, 14 m long, 9 m wide at the end, with a brighter inner cone and an amber lamp point. Faces +Z.

name: Light Shaft
description: 30 m tall tapered light shaft from the surface, three nested translucent cylinders so the centre reads brighter. Stand it vertically in shallow water.

name: Bubble Column
description: Sixteen translucent bubbles of growing size rising in a loose column about 4.1 m tall. Scale or animate upward.

name: Sonar Pulse Rings
description: Three concentric thin rings (3, 6, 9 m radius) plus a glowing centre disc. Animate the scale to make an expanding sonar wave.

name: Shockwave Ring
description: Flared ring-shaped shockwave, 8 m across, with a bright glowing inner lip. Expand and fade for hit and landing effects.

name: Energy Orb
description: Glowing core inside a translucent shell with three orbiting rings (cyan and amber). Usable as a charge-up, projectile or power core.

name: Spark Burst
description: Twenty-eight radial spikes (alternating cyan and amber) around a hot core. Spin and scale up for a hit-spark or explosion flash.

name: Current Vortex
description: Two translucent ribbons spiralling three turns up an 8 m column: the look of a strong deep-sea current or whirlpool. Rotate slowly around Y.

name: Shard Crystal
description: Currency pickup: a cluster of six glowing cyan crystals on a small stone base, about 1.3 m tall.

name: Relic Tablet
description: Relic pickup: a small stone tablet on a base with a glowing ring glyph and an amber stud, about 1.2 m tall.

name: Healing Pearl
description: Healing pickup: an open stone bivalve cradling a glass pearl with a green glowing heart.

name: Sunken Treasure Chest
description: Closed barrel-lidded wooden chest with iron bands, a gold lock plate and a glowing keyhole, 1.3 m wide.

name: Ancient Coins
description: A stack of five gold coins with a glowing glyph ring on top and two loose coins beside it.

name: Rune Key
description: Key pickup: gold key with a round bow, three teeth and a glowing glyph gem. 1.2 m tall.

name: Basalt Column Cluster
description: Eleven six-sided basalt columns of different heights (0.8-4.2 m): the rock of the blue-phosphor basin, and a fine cliff dressing.

name: Large Boulder
description: A big lumpy boulder (4.2 m wide) with five smaller lumps around its base. Use as seabed cover or a wall.

name: Sunken Anchor
description: Rusted iron anchor standing upright, 4.6 m tall, with a ring, stock bar, curved arms and a little coral growth.

name: Hydrothermal Vent Chimney
description: Stacked stone chimney 4.6 m tall with a glowing amber mouth, ringed by small stalks with glowing green tips.

name: Crate Stack
description: Three wooden crates with iron straps stacked and tilted, plus a banded barrel. Shipwreck and supply-cache dressing.

name: Fan Coral
description: Fan-shaped sea fan: a stem on a stone base fanning into eleven branches with glowing tips and three arcs of fine mesh. 3.2 m wide.
